missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Чиновник' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'сидит'. 'Важный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в кабинете' locates him.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Чиновника' is the accusative, equal to the genitive because the noun is animate masculine. 'Этого' agrees in the animate accusative. A natural news sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Чиновника' takes the genitive after 'у' to show whose salary it is. 'Большая зарплата' stands in the nominative. A common possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Чиновнику' is the dative, the person the letter goes to. 'Письмо' is the accusative object. A practical bureaucratic pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'С чиновником' uses the instrumental form 'чиновником' after 'с' to mark the person spoken with. 'Долго' adds duration. A useful conversation frame.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О чиновнике' uses the prepositional form 'чиновнике' after 'о' to mark the topic of the article. 'В газете' locates the report. A natural media frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Чиновники' is the nominative plural subject of 'приняли'. 'Местные' agrees in the plural, and 'решение' is the accusative object. A clean plural model.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. 'Чиновникам' is the dative plural required by 'не доверяют', which governs the dative. A useful pattern for expressing attitudes.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Чиновников' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Слишком' adds the critical tone, and 'в стране' sets the scope. A natural quantity complaint.

Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Чиновник' is nominative as the subject. 'Этот' agrees as masculine and 'честный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive card.
